question: How does the octad of fields correspond to the heart-lotus and which sites begin the list?
premises: The octad of fields is addressed to knowers of the field.
This octad corresponds to the eight petals of the heart-lotus.
The list begins with Prayāga, Varaṇā, then Aṭṭahāsa and Jayantikā.
inference: The external octad of sacred fields is mapped onto the eight petals of the heart-lotus, beginning with Prayāga, Varaṇā, Aṭṭahāsa, and Jayantikā.
uncertainties: The full assignment of each field to a specific petal is not given in this verse alone.
plain_english: O knowers of the field, the octad of fields corresponds to the eight petals of the heart-lotus: Prayāga, Varaṇā, then Aṭṭahāsa and Jayantikā.
